rules.native_first: National classifications, stages, currencies and accounting scopes are retained without coercion.
rules.harmonised_layer: Cross-country comparisons use separately identified IMF, OECD/COFOG or SHA observations.
rules.missingness: Unavailable, pending and not-applicable values are explicit and are never encoded as zero.
rules.non_additivity: National, local, social-insurance and public-corporation layers must not be added without eliminating internal transfers.
rules.lineage: Every module names its production artifact and official source registry.
